key_insight: ConsID-Gen combines data-level multi-view augmentation with model-level identity- and view-consistency constraints to generate temporally coherent videos from a single image while preserving fine-grained object identity across changing viewpoints.
problem_solved: Addresses appearance drift and geometric distortion in image-to-video (I2V) generation caused by sparse single-view observations and weak cross-modal alignment, enabling stable identity preservation as viewpoint and motion change.
method: Data augmentation: synthesize or mine pseudo multi-view observations from the single input to densify geometric and appearance supervision.
Model constraints: introduce identity-preserving and view-consistency losses (cross-frame feature matching / perceptual identity regularizers) to prevent appearance drift.
Cross-modal & temporal alignment: strengthen image–text alignment and temporal modeling (e.g., sequence-conditioned generator) so animations follow instructions while remaining consistent over time.
impact: Makes I2V outputs more reliable for applications that require faithful identity preservation (avatars, digital doubles, AR/VR, visual effects) and reduces common artifacts, improving usability for practitioners deploying generative video systems.
visual_elements: Before/after strip: single input image on the left, generated video frames across time on the right to show preserved identity under viewpoint change.
Pipeline diagram: blocks for multi-view augmentation → consistency & identity losses → temporally-conditioned generator, with arrows showing information flow.
Metric chart: ID-similarity-over-time or identity-drift curve comparing ConsID-Gen vs baseline (qualitative or quantitative trend illustration).
Feature-space visualization: t-SNE/embedding trajectories of features from frames demonstrating tighter identity clustering with ConsID-Gen.
paper_title: ConsID-Gen: View-Consistent and Identity-Preserving Image-to-Video Generation
paper_authors: Mingyang Wu, Ashirbad Mishra, Soumik Dey, Shuo Xing, Naveen Ravipati
